free_tier.stated: Lifetime Personal 500 GB $229 (list $344); Lifetime Personal+ 2 TB $499 (list $749). Growth is by 'stack' add-ons (1 TB / 5 TB) or by attaching a subscription.
free_tier.notes: Headline offer; binding constraint specified in limits.

per_object_cap.stated: No per-object cap documented in published terms; absence is not an unlimited claim.
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: Refund terms disagree between the lifetime page (30 days) and ToS (14 days).

egress.terms: No egress fee published. Vendor explicitly frames lifetime as 'Made for casual use — ideal for everyday uploads and access. Power users and heavier workloads may be better suited to a flexible subscription plan', which is a soft fair-use brake rather than a number.

interface_detail: WebDAV + rclone generic; desktop/mobile apps; virtual drive on Windows
limits_note: Stacks cannot be combined with each other arbitrarily. Icedrive community staff: 'Its not possible to stack lifetime plans on top of one another. Only by purchasing Stacks .. can you add more storage.' So the 2 TB entry point is a ceiling unless you buy 5 TB stacks.
reliability_note: No mass data-loss event documented. Pricing has churned violently across 2024-2026 (Black Friday $349 for 3 TB, then a $389 2 TB Core, now $499) which is a signal about unit economics, not integrity. Refund terms disagree between the lifetime page (30 days) and ToS (14 days).
confidence_note: mechanically converted from the seed corpus; no page was read for this record in the storage-dossier pass. One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: 'Lifetime Personal+ 2 TB ... $749 $499 One-time payment'; '30-day money-back guarantee'; 'Ideal for everyday uploads and access. Power users and heavier workloads may be better suited to a flexible subscription plan'

price_per_tb_month: One-time $249.50/TB at 2 TB ($499). Over 5 years: $4.16/TB/mo. Over 10 years: $2.08/TB/mo. Expensive relative to pCloud at the same capacity.
